title: Sow what the map plans
about: Cells you marked as planned on the PermTek-5 map become sowing jobs. The depth, the number of seeds and the spacing come from the crop.

steps.title: The plan
steps.why: Hatched cells in the bed are planned, not sown. For each, the page proposes a sowing job: where (millimetres from the bed's home corner), how deep, how many seeds.

steps.title: Robot: sow the first planned cell
steps.why: The gantry lifts the tool, moves over the cell's centre, lowers it to the sowing depth, drops the seeds and lifts again. Nothing moves before you confirm.

steps.title: The cell is sown
steps.why: The cell changes from planned to sown and a seedling stands in the bed. When the world was prepared from your own site, this is written to its map with today's date at the next sync.

steps.title: Robot: a picture of what is planted
steps.why: After the days a crop needs to germinate, a camera pass shows whether each point came up. Here it runs straight away, one picture per planted cell.
